title: ABVP, SFI clash over bookstall in Kolkata’s College Street

ai.summary: Students' Federation of India (SFI) and Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) clashed in Kolkata's College Street over bookstall permissions, with police reporting no critical injuries or arrests by evening.

facts.claim: SFI has been selling books in Kolkata since last month to protest vandalism at book stalls
facts.quote: The Students’ Federation of India has been selling books in Kolkata since last month to protest vandalism at book stalls

facts.claim: Stones, firecrackers, eggs and water bottles were hurled during the standoff
facts.quote: Stones, firecrackers, eggs and water bottles were hurled during the standoff

facts.claim: Police said no one sustained any critical injury, and no arrests were made until 7 pm
facts.quote: police said no one sustained any critical injury, and no arrests were made until 7 pm

facts.claim: The SFI was given permission to set up a temporary stall and elaborate security arrangements were made
facts.quote: The SFI was given permission to set up a temporary stall and elaborate security arrangements were made to maintain law and order

facts.claim: ABVP members arrived around noon and tried to break through the steel barricades set up by the police
facts.quote: The ABVP members arrived around noon and tried to break through the steel barricades set up by the police

facts.claim: Police permitted the ABVP to set up a similar stall on the other side of the barricade
facts.quote: We permitted the ABVP to set up a similar stall on the other side of the barricade

facts.claim: ABVP activists refused to believe that the SFI had permission to set up the stall
facts.quote: The ABVP activists refused to believe that the SFI had permission to set up the stall

facts.claim: Police said movement of vehicular traffic and pedestrians was suspended
facts.quote: Police said movement of vehicular traffic and pedestrians was suspended

facts.claim: SFI members alleged that stones, eggs and crackers were thrown at them
facts.quote: The SFI members alleged that stones, eggs and crackers were thrown at them

facts.claim: SFI left College Street by 7 pm; however, the ABVP members accused them of hurling similar objects
facts.quote: SFI left College Street by 7 pm; however, the ABVP members accused them of hurling similar objects

facts.claim: The SFI has been selling books in Kolkata since last month to protest vandalism at book stalls set up by the CPI(M), CPI and the CPI (Marxist-Leninist) Liberation during the Durga Puja festival by members of various Hindutva groups
facts.quote: The SFI has been selling books in Kolkata since last month to protest vandalism at book stalls set up by the CPI(M), CPI and the CPI (Marxist-Leninist) Liberation during the Durga Puja festival by members of various Hindutva groups

facts.claim: Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya said, 'There is bound to be some trouble if these two organisations face each other. ABVP is not the BJP’s students’ front. The two organisations will settle the issue among themselves.'
facts.quote: Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya said, 'There is bound to be some trouble if these two organisations face each other. ABVP is not the BJP’s students’ front. The two organisations will settle the issue among themselves.'

ai.background_note: SFI has been selling books in Kolkata to protest vandalism at book stalls by Hindutva groups during Durga Puja festival.
